t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are six gnomes. Each gnome has a different colored basket to collect mushrooms. It is important to identify which colored basket corresponds to each gnome. Once this has been identified, it will make the basket selection easier. What baskets do I have? The yellow basket, has blue, brownish and yellow. All colored baskets had yellow, but no red. The red basket, has purple, pink, and reddish-brown. If the mushroom value decreases by 1-2, pick the other basket. For example: If by selecting the red basket, the mushroom value decreases by 1-2, start picking yellow basket instead.

vb_textbox.text: There are six gnomes, each a different color (pink, brown, green, blue, purple, yellow). There will be two different baskets for collecting mushrooms, one is Red and the other Yellow. Each gnome corresponds to either the Red or the Yellow basket. Once you identify which colored gnome matches to either basket, it is easier to select. For example, the Blue, Brown, and Yellow gnomes will correspond to the Yellow basket. While the Pink, Purple, and Green gnomes will match up with the Red basket. If the mushroom value decreases by 1-2, begin to pick the other gnomes that correspond with the other basket. For example, if Red basket was doing well but collection number of mushrooms decreases, start picking gnomes that select the Yellow basket.
